purpose: Correct the interpretation of existing measurements without altering any measurement. Every number below is unchanged; what changes is the status, the label, or the claim attached to it. Dated audits are not rewritten -- AGENTS.md keeps superseded strings in immutable audits as provenance -- so this file is the active carrier and the earlier files stand as history.

corrections.topic: the external C2ST corpus is below the frozen event minimum
corrections.defect: 8,000 total examples is below the frozen min_total_evaluation_events of 10,000 in configs/gates_primary.yaml.
corrections.new_label: FOLLOW-UP QA -- BELOW FROZEN EVENT MINIMUM
consequences: may NOT be used to pass or fail the 0.65 diagnostic
may NOT be used to select a row
superseded by the gate-compliant fixed 10,000-pair battery built in Phase C
corrections.explicitly_not_done: B0 is NOT unfrozen or rewritten. Baseline identity and metric sufficiency are separate statuses: dicos-f-02 epoch 90 remains the immutable development baseline with its structural and lineage gate intact.

corrections.topic: S1 carries two distinct conclusions, not one

labels.S1_CONFIGURATION_NOT_PROMOTED: the completed configuration was worse in validation loss than the available control and remains off in downstream configs unless later evidence satisfies the frozen promotion rule
labels.S1_AXIS_CAUSAL_EFFECT_UNRESOLVED: S1 used a fresh Adam while dicos-f-03 resumed optimizer state, and S1 was selected on validation loss alone even though the frozen v3 plan required off-axis/topology targets, paired bootstrap, guard metrics, and C2ST

corrections.wording_required: 0.022082 / 0.000654 = 33.8 is 33.8x the mean-absolute run-to-run reference. It is NOT a standard error, a p-value, a confidence interval, or a 34-sigma significance.
corrections.wording_withdrawn: an earlier internal summary described the ratio as sigma-equivalent; that phrasing is withdrawn
corrections.not_permitted: deleting S1 or relabelling it positive. It is valid negative evidence for the combined executed configuration.

required_wording: a growing train-validation gap consistent with overfitting is established on the measured lineage
aggregate validation loss is not a sufficient row-selection statistic
loss/fidelity relationship is under-resolved and not shown to be anti-correlated
not_permitted: stating that nearest-neighbour memorization is established -- the memorization metric has not been run, and the Phase C battery records computed:false without a declared train reference
restoring the withdrawn claim that lower loss made the physics worse

corrections.topic: C2ST definitions must not be mixed
corrections.withdrawn_claim: that the learning-rate correction 'nearly cleared' the D1 0.02 acceptance gate
corrections.why_withdrawn: the -0.019193 delta is a hybrid-C2ST quantity while the D1 promotion rule names low-level C2ST. Comparing them requires proof that the same feature set, classifier family, corpus, split and delta definition were used, and no such proof exists.
corrections.forward_requirement: report high-level, low-level, hybrid and profile-aware C2ST separately, and compare each only with its matching frozen gate or control. The Phase C battery emits exactly these four families and never merges them.
corrections.gate_unchanged: the D1/D2 required absolute C2ST improvement of 0.02 is NOT re-derived. Current evidence is insufficient. Any future change is a separate owner decision with a versioned gate carrying old and new hashes and tests.

corrections.topic: the zero-response excess cannot explain the AUROC
corrections.conclusion: the marginal zero-rate difference alone yields at most AUROC 0.507 and therefore cannot explain the measured 0.843. It may still be a useful joint feature.
corrections.still_a_defect: a second zero atom remains a structural model defect worth repairing, which is what the S2 bounded response spline addresses.
corrections.withdrawn_question: an earlier internal question asked whether the zero excess was a plausible dominant driver of AUROC 0.843; the bound above answers no, and the question is withdrawn as ill-posed.
corrections.implementation: the Phase C battery decomposes the zero rate into the visibility hurdle and the positive branch, so the S2 target is measured directly rather than inferred from the marginal rate.
